environment.description: Tomcat 9.0 servlet container running on EC2 instance. PostgreSQL 14 database with standard pg_hba.conf allowing md5 auth from application subnet. DB user 'inventory_app' has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on inventory schema. Application is exposed via an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) on port 443 with TLS termination, no additional request inspection. No query-level firewall or proxy between application and database.

config.db_user_privileges: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON schema inventory
config.network: app-subnet direct to db-subnet, no intermediary proxy
